status: specification only -- not consumed by any executable component in this repository
description: Structured object an INDEPENDENT, non-LLM completion-attestation authority (see SPEC_v1.md) would validate before authorizing a bounded canonical completion transition. This schema is documentation; no code in this repository issues, signs, or consumes an object of this shape.

priority_or_task_id.description: exact canonical item_id: rank_id, or rank_id/component_id

completion_contract_version.description: must equal the contract file's own completion_contract_version field

verifier_receipt_path.description: path to the exact completion_verifier.py receipt under mr_silent_spine/walkaway_governance/verifier_receipts/

verifier_receipt_sha256.description: sha256 of that receipt file, independently recomputed by the authority at validation time -- never trusted as copied from the attestation payload alone

current_canonical_state.description: status the authority itself read from founder_priority_state.json at validation time

validation_sequence_reference: See SPEC_v1.md section 4 for the 9-step independent validation sequence performed against live state before this object may authorize anything. No field in this object is self-proving; every field with a corresponding live check must be independently re-derived and compared, not trusted at face value.
authorization_scope: A valid object of this shape authorizes exactly one thing: the bounded atomic transition of priority_or_task_id's status field to 'complete' in mr_silent_spine/state/founder_priority_state.json, plus one append to completion_transitions_v1.jsonl. It authorizes nothing else -- no worker execution, no further classification, no protected operation of any kind.
